verifyPrev.futureEditionText: 27 May 2027, a single-day fifth edition at Restaurant Le Chef, Genève Aéroport, Geneva, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland (Geneva Airport corridor, not downtown Geneva or Founex). TRAVEL INSIDE published the actual activity date on 12 October 2026; the Swiss Travel Federation calendar independently lists “27 mai 2027” and “by Genève Aéroport”. This is within the requested horizon. Important provenance
verifyPrev.venueText: 2027 venue publicly announced as Le Chef; signed contract not reviewed. This does not establish a hotel commitment.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two commercially relevant organizer contacts identified: Nicolas Simonin, Responsable développement tourisme/transport, and Yves-Daniel Viredaz, Head of Business Development, both at Genève Aéroport. Their series-organizer roles are explicitly documented for 2025, both appear in the 2026 organizing team, and the official 2026 event page directs exhibitor registrations to Nicolas. They are relevant first contacts for the announced 2027 edition by inference, not explicitly appointed 2027 buyers in the sources reviewed.
findings.futureEdition: Fifth edition announced for 27 May 2027 at Restaurant Le Chef, Genève Aéroport, Geneva, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. TRAVEL INSIDE published the date on 12 October 2026; the FSV calendar independently lists the same date and identifies Genève Aéroport as organizer.
findings.venueCommitments: Restaurant Le Chef is the publicly announced 2027 venue. A signed venue contract was not reviewed; this announcement does not establish a hotel-room commitment.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing unconfirmed. Reviewed event announcements and the preceding edition’s registration materials do not identify an accommodation programme, incumbent hotel or room-block buyer; silence is not evidence of open sourcing.
findings.organizationStructure: Genève Aéroport organizes the workshop. TRAVEL INSIDE is explicitly described as media partner, not event owner; the publishing brand should not be substituted for the organizer.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Email Nicolas Simonin at the publicly listed event-registration address nicolas.simonin@gva.ch, referencing GVA Workshop on 27 May 2027. Ask him to confirm his 2027 remit and whether out-of-area exhibitors, speakers or organizers require overnight accommodation. If a need exists, discuss a small ancillary block at YOTEL Geneva Lake and verify transfer requirements; do not pitch replacement of the announced venue or assume catering demand. Yves-Daniel Viredaz is a secondary relationship contact.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: The 2027 event venue is already announced as Le Chef. No accessible hotel contract or room inventory is established. Contacting the organizer is a qualification step, not evidence of a live accommodation tender.

suggestedOrsFollowUps: Ask Nicolas Simonin whether he is responsible for GVA Workshop on 27 May 2027 and who handles any exhibitor, speaker or organizer accommodation. Confirm whether any overnight requirement exists before qualifying a room opportunity.
remainingUncertainties: Neither the 2027 announcement nor the 2027 calendar names an edition-specific contact. Nicolas Simonin and Yves-Daniel Viredaz are verified series organizers/contact candidates; their responsibility for the 2027 edition remains to be confirmed.

No published hotel-sourcing process, accommodation buyer, room block, peak-room requirement or incumbent hotel was identified in the reviewed event sources. Neither person is established as controlling hotel contracts.
